name: Fluval Plant 3.0 36W (61-85 cm)
description: Bluetooth-controlled LED with the FluvalSmart app for programmable sunrise/sunset ramping, cloud cover effects, and per-channel intensity. Manufacturer specifies 32W input draw for the 36W-class fixture; the 36W figure is the LED-array rating, not the wall draw. Fluval publishes 2,350 lm, 6500K, and a 120-degree per-LED beam for this size; light.fixtureLengthMm records the 610 mm housing at minimum bracket extension (extendable to 850 mm).
